title: Tracktopia
description:
Tracktopia is a strategy game with city-building elements, where your city moves on tracks and serves as a super powerful unit. The goal of the game is to destroy the enemy nation. Boost your city's production to create more units. Don’t forget to invest in research as well, enabling you to develop more efficient buildings and stronger units. Achieve this by constructing districts in Tracktopia—there are 10 different types available.

Build!

Your city is powerful but not indestructible, so you'll need smaller units. There are 5 types of units:

• Tanks

• Fighters

• Bombers

• Helicopters

• Drones

Each of them can destroy specific types of units. For example, a tank cannot shoot down a bomber, but a bomber can successfully bomb a tank.

Units, as well as some districts, can be upgraded through research, which is divided into 3 eras inspired by the 20th and 21st centuries:

• World War II

• Cold War

• Modern Era

Tracktopia itself is also a unit! It has a massive amount of HP and can destroy everything in its path. However, these powerful traits are balanced by a limited number of movements per turn and the fact that losing the city means the end of the game. Therefore, you must protect Tracktopia and carefully utilize its crushing power.

Charge into action!
description_short: Tracktopia is a strategy game with city-building elements, where your city moves on tracks and serves as a super powerful unit. Expand it to boost production, advance technologies, and create smaller units to ultimately defeat the enemy nation!
